testCases.title: Verify all product information is displayed on the product detail page
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
expectedResults: All product information including image, name, description, price, category badge, and brand badge is displayed correctly.

testCases.title: Verify related products section is displayed below main product information
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
expectedResults: The section with related products is displayed below the main product information.

testCases.title: Verify clickable related products navigate to respective detail pages
preconditions: Related products are displayed on the product detail page.
expectedResults: Each click navigates to the respective related product detail page.
